podcast.title: Chris Shiflett's Solo Project
podcast.body: Jackson United is the name under which Foo Fighter Chris Shiflett recorded a solo album. Taylor Hawkins played drums on this project, demonstrating the collaborative spirit among Foo Fighters members. "When fellow Foo fighter Chris Schiflett wanted to record a solo album under the name Jackson United, who was playing drums, Taylor Hawkins."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Guest Appearances and Collaborations
xref.body: Taylor Hawkins was known for his willingness to assist other bands and artists. He performed on albums by Coheed and Cambria (also touring with them), Eric Avery (Jane's Addiction bassist), Chris Shiflett (Foo Fighter, for Jackson United project), Slash, Ozzy Osborne, and Elton John. "And like his boss and friend, Taylor was always willing to help out other bands."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
